query:
insert into rating_history
               (tenant_id, user_id, seq, game_id, adjustment_id, won, delta, rating_after, at)
           select $1, * from unnest($2::bigint[], $3::int[], $4::bigint[], $5::bigint[],
                                    $6::boolean[], $7::int[], $8::int[], $9::timestamptz[])
